answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation tied to verifiable work history: each agent earns standing only by completing attested tasks, and new identities start at zero regardless of how many are spawned. Like a walnut grove that takes seasons to grow, trust accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight; a sybil swarm is just saplings on a ridge — visible, shallow-rooted, and easy to prune before it ever reaches the canopy.
